items.claim: Indices slider re-sorts its thumbs mid-drag, so the held thumb's styling and focus jump to the neighbor
items.note: The slider now uses `constraint="ordered"`, and the sort moved from `onInput` to `onChange`, so a newly added thumb still ends up in order.

items.claim: Tightening the bounds mode can invert the ordered L range
A failed PDF write still offers the previous PDF for download
StrokeTrimLab's palette offers a Select tool its canvas never mounts
QuantityDemo's BandEditor drops Escape-cancel, so a canceled drag stays shown
items.note: Under the edit protocol (`docs/conventions.md`, "Edit callbacks"), the control sends `onInput` the value the edit began from before it calls `onCancel`, so `live` is already back to the committed bands. A repro test (seam drag, then Escape) passed on the frozen tree, so I dropped it.

items.claim: RigDemo's "track u" readout keeps its value after the track stops
items.note: The existing test asserted `track u 1.00` after stop; it now expects `0.00`.

items.claim: SvgDemo writes the old scene under the wrong viewBox while the source fails to parse
items.note: `parseSvg` never throws on bad input; it returns `{ nodes: [], error }`. So the scene is emptied and the export is an empty SVG under the default view, which is consistent. A repro test showed exactly that, so I dropped it.

items.claim: RegistryDemo's registry is module-level, so entries outlive unmount and are shared between copies
RigDemo's "joint labels" checkbox also hides both captions
items.note: The captions now sit on a `captions` layer of their own.

items.claim: RepeatAlongLab builds its copies from the schema defaults, not the trial's config, so a seeded trial or a Reset disagrees with the panel
RectPathEditLab's path-edit host outlives a Reset, so a reset trial doesn't reopen rect-1
Labs using `defaultPathEdit` don't reopen their path on Reset
items.note: question (should labkit's `TrialSceneCanvas` reapply `defaultPathEdit` when the trial resets?). This covers RepeatAlong, Spiro, SegmentType and others. core's `usePathEdit` applies the opening only on mount, and a Reset doesn't remount the trial, so whatever path was open stays open. It's the same gap as the RectPathEdit finding, but the fix belongs in labkit or core rather than a demo, so I left it alone.

items.claim: BendAlongLabDemo seeds its effect from `config.defaults()` the same way RepeatAlong did
items.note: question (fix it in its own area's pass?). That file is outside this area, so I didn't touch it.
